title: South Korea National Wage Data by Occupation (KSCO 7th revision major group, no region dimension)

admin_code.description: Always 'KR-NAT'. 고용형태별근로실태조사 (the source of this table) is a national-only survey with zero regional dimension -- confirmed via full-text scan (zero occurrences of '시도' or '지역' in the 2024 report) and corroborated verbatim by KOSTAT in KOSIS Q&A #24532 (https://kosis.kr/civilComplaint/qnaDetail.do?boardIdx=24532).

enum: Skilled agricultural, forestry and fishery workers
Equipment, machine operating and assembling workers
occupation_category.description: KSCO (Korean Standard Classification of Occupations) 7th-revision major-group (대분류) English label. 'Armed Forces' (군인, code A) is excluded -- the wage table in the source report contains exactly 9 civilian categories plus the 'All occupations' total, omitting Armed Forces entirely.

occupation_code.description: KSCO 7th-revision major-group digit. '0' is used here for the 'All occupations' total row (not an official KSCO code, a convention of this module). 1-9 are the official KSCO major-group digits. 'A' (Armed Forces) is defined by KSCO but never appears in this table because wage statistics exclude it.

wage_value.description: 월 임금총액 (monthly total wage) in units given by 'currency' and 'wage_period'. Leave null + data_availability='not_available' rather than estimating.

wage_measure.description: 월 임금총액 -- monthly total wage for 상용근로자 in 5+-person establishments, June 2024 payroll reference period. This is the only wage_measure populated in this pass (the report also has hourly wage and regular/non-regular splits -- see README section 8, Extending this later).

classification_system.description: Korean Standard Classification of Occupations, 7th revision (통계청 고시, 2017-07-03), major-group (대분류) level. This is the classification actually used in the 2024 wage report; KSCO 8th revision takes effect 2025-01-01 and is used by a different survey (지역별고용조사), not this one.

data_availability.description: The only value that appears in this table. 고용형태별근로실태조사 has no regional dimension at all, so no row in this table can ever have finer-than-national granularity -- this is a structural fact, not a data gap.
